name: Kiyokawa Ikuto
source:
The student council president. He is Hajime, Hikari, and Shinji's childhood friend. His grades are excellent and he is good-looking, so he is popular with the girls at school. His personality conflicts with Hajime's so he tends to oppose him. He has a grudge against Hajime because he treated him badly when they were kids, like leaving him behind in a game of hide-and-seek. He is in love with Hikari.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/タペストリー_-you_will_meet_yourself-]Wikipedia[/url]]
